articles.title: Man Utd knocked out of FA Cup by Brighton, Martinelli hits hat-trick for Arsenal
articles.mainIdea: Man Utd knocked out of FA Cup by Brighton, Martinelli hits hat-trick for Arsenal
articles.summary: AFP: Man Utd knocked out of FA Cup by Brighton, Martinelli hits hat-trick for Arsenal. Manchester United crashed out of the FA Cup with a meek 2-1 home defeat to Brighton on Sunday as Gabriel Martinelli's hat-trick fired Arsenal to a 4-1 win at Portsmouth to reach round four.Gabriel Jesus teed up Martinelli to kill the tie off early in the second period before he completed his hat-trick from another Arsenal corner.

articles.title: AC Milan snatch late draw at Fiorentina as title rivals Inter face Napoli
articles.mainIdea: AC Milan snatch late draw at Fiorentina as title rivals Inter face Napoli
articles.summary: AFP: AC Milan snatch late draw at Fiorentina as title rivals Inter face Napoli. AC Milan missed the chance to join Inter Milan at the top of Serie A on Sunday after snatching a late 1-1 draw at Fiorentina, ahead of their local rivals' clash with Scudetto rivals Napoli.Milan are at risk of falling five points off the title pace later on Sunday as Inter face reigning champions Napoli hunting a seventh straight league success.
